queries.Core loss design: We propose to develop: smooth convex GAN discriminator loss with regularization and scaling parameters that stabilizes gradients, reduces sensitivity to outliers, and provides controllable gradient updates for generative adversarial network training
queries.Loss property design: Our methodology ce: smooth convex Lipschitz continuous GAN discriminator loss with epsilon regularization preventing abrupt gradient changes near zero and alpha scaling for flexible gradient magnitude control and training stability
queries.GAN integration: We will integrate this: GAN framework integrating a zephyr loss for discriminator training to measure closeness between discriminator outputs and target values, with feature matching generator objective to align generated samples with real data distribution and stabilize gradients
queries.Diffusion extension: We will also develo: Diffusion-GAN training using a smooth convex discriminator loss to stabilize gradients and improve generated image quality
queries.Theoretical validation: We will provide: Mathematical convergence proof for zephyr loss in GANs, uniqueness of the optimal discriminator, and relationship to distribution matching in generative adversarial training
queries.Benchmark evaluation: We will evaluate o: Benchmark evaluation of GAN image generation on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, STL-10, and SVHN to assess performance across image sizes and complexities, using Inception Score, FID, and KID for ZGAN and Diffusion-ZGAN.
queries.Baseline comparison: We will compare ZGA: Baseline comparison of GAN methods with DCGAN architectures on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, STL-10, SVHN, evaluating Inception Score, FID, KID for LSGAN, WGAN, Diffusion-GAN, novel gradient-controlled discriminator loss.
queries.Hyperparameter optimization: We will sys: Systematic hyperparameter optimization of alpha and epsilon in a smooth convex GAN loss with flexible gradient control for discriminator and generator training on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, STL-10, and SVHN.
queries.Evaluation metrics: We will assess model: Evaluating generated image quality and distributional fidelity in generative adversarial networks using Inception Score, Fréchet Inception Distance, Kernel Inception Distance, and qualitative visual assessment of generated samples
queries.Ablation studies: We will conduct detail: Ablation studies of epsilon regularization and alpha scaling in zephyr loss for GAN discriminator training on CIFAR-10, evaluating impact on gradient stability, Inception Score, FID, and generator performance.
queries.Training configuration: All models will: consistent DCGAN training setup batch size 64 Adam learning rate 0.0002 beta1 0.5 RMSProp WGAN true fake labels 1 0 for comparing GAN loss functions
